description: Paulo Coelho, regarded by millions as an alchemist of words, is one of this centurys most influential writers. His books not only make it to the top of the bestseller lists, they also provoke social and cultural debate. He deals with subjects, ideas and philosophies that touch the aspirations of those many readers who are in search of their own path and of new ways of understanding the world.
title: Paulo Coelho Moments 2012 Day Planner

reviewText:
Last year family and friends enjoyed their 2011 agendas.

The books are not only helpful diaries but the pictures are amazing and all of  quotes along the way are inspirational too.  No matter how rocky the day, you can open the book anywhere and find something beautiful.

So when 2012 was released I sent two copies along to my daughter.  One is for donation to a student in need.  She's grateful and pleased about the extra for sharing.

Thankyou Paulo, Artist and Publisher!
